subject: Staged remediation commitments and scan cadence — SOC2 evidence handoff
messages:
From: Alex Mercer <alex.mercer@finway.com>
To: chloe_martin@redwood.com
Cc: Priya Singh <priya@vendorsec.com>
Date: 2028-07-19T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: SOC2 evidence request — VM cadence and remediation SLAs

Hi Chloe,

Thanks for the quick onboarding call this morning. As part of our SOC2 review we need a concise package that demonstrates Redwood's vulnerability management posture for the deployed inference service that handles Finway data. Specifically we need:

- Recent scan cadence (tools used, scan frequency)
- SLA for CVE remediation by severity (P1/P2/P3 definitions and timelines)
- Evidence of recent CVE closures or a remediation plan with owners and ETA
- A signed attestation we can include in our audit package

Can you send a single ZIP or a set of files with the above items by EOD tomorrow? If there are any open high-severity items, please include the staging plan and expected closure dates.

Alex
Security Lead, Finway Payments
From: chloe_martin@redwood.com
To: Alex Mercer <alex.mercer@finway.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com, rishi_malhotra@redwood.com
Date: 2028-07-19T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: SOC2 evidence request — VM cadence and remediation SLAs

Alex —

Thanks for the clear ask. Attaching a short packet that covers:

- scan cadence summary (tool: Trivy + internal nightly agent; infra scans weekly, image scans on build, critical-path binary scans daily)
- remediation_matrix.xlsx (owner, CVE id, status, severity, target close date)
- vm_scan_summary.csv (summary of last 30 days with severity counts)

Quick notes:
- SLA by severity (internal definitions): P1 (Critical) = 72 hours to mitigation plan + 14 days to patch where possible; P2 (High) = 7 days; P3 (Medium) = 30 days; Low = next maintenance window. We apply compensating controls and temporary mitigations for infra components that require scheduled maintenance.
- For any externally-hosted model infrastructure, we mark dependencies as third-party and include vendor remediation commitments in the matrix.

We have one P1 (CVE-2028-2145) currently in a staged remediation state; Rishi is the owner and has a canary patch planned for tomorrow with full rollout by Monday. Details in remediation_matrix.xlsx.

If you want a short signed attestation, I can route to legal for signature — otherwise I can prepare a team-signed PDF and send it.

-Chloe
Chloe Martin
Manager, Security & Compliance
Redwood Inference

Attachments: 2028-07-19_vm_scan_summary.csv (csv, 12KB), 2028-07-19_remediation_matrix.xlsx (xlsx, 48KB)

To: chloe_martin@redwood.com, rishi_malhotra@redwood.com
Cc: Alex Mercer <alex.mercer@finway.com>, Priya Singh <priya@vendorsec.com>
Date: 2028-07-19T13:06:00-07:00
Subject: Re: SOC2 evidence request — VM cadence and remediation SLAs

Looping in a quick clarification for auditors:

Alex / Priya — the SLA language Chloe provided maps to our internal incident categories. For the SOC2 package we recommend we include both the SLA timelines and the operational step sequence (e.g., detection -> triage -> mitigation -> verification). I've added a one-page flow to the Drive link included above.

Chloe — can you also include the escalation play for the P1 (who to call if the canary fails / rollback steps)? That will help Finway sign off faster.

Marissa
Head of Customer Success (delivering Finway engagement)
Redwood Inference
From: rishi_malhotra@redwood.com
To: marissa_cole@redwood.com, chloe_martin@redwood.com
Cc: Alex Mercer <alex.mercer@finway.com>
Date: 2028-07-19T16:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: SOC2 evidence request — VM cadence and remediation SLAs

Marissa / Chloe —

Status update on CVE-2028-2145 (P1):
- Triage completed, root cause: vulnerable dependency in model-serving runtime.
- Canary patch scheduled: 2028-07-20T03:00Z (low-traffic window).
- Full rollout: expected 2028-07-22T11:00Z if canary shows no regressions.
- Rollback plan: artifact revert + traffic drain; escalation contact: rishi_malhotra@redwood.com, on-call infra lead Tomas Becker.

I'll update the remediation_matrix.xlsx with the canary run ID and verification checklist after execution. If the canary fails we'll move to hotfix + extended rollback plan and notify Finway immediately.

Rishi
Senior SRE, Redwood Inference

Alex / Priya —

Thanks — delivering the finalized evidence bundle as requested. Files attached and uploaded to the shared Drive link: https://drive.redwood.com/soc2/Finway/2028-07-evidence

What we included:
- 2028-07-19_vm_scan_summary.csv — last 30 days scan output (counts + hashes)
- 2028-07-19_remediation_matrix.xlsx — owners, status, ETAs (updated with canary schedule)
- 2028-07-20_staged_remediation_attestation_signed.pdf — team-signed attestation stating: "Redwood maintains a documented VM cadence, defined SLAs for remediation, and has committed to staged remediation for active P1 items with appropriate rollback controls." (signed by Chloe Martin and Marissa Cole)
- One-page SLA mapping and escalation flow (in Drive).

Note on CVE-2028-2145: canary executed successfully at 2028-07-20T03:12:00Z; initial verification checks passed. Target full rollout remains 2028-07-22T11:00Z. We will notify you on completion and provide the final verification log.

If you need a notarized/legal-signed attestation for the SOC2 binder, we can route to Legal — let me know and I'll expedite.

Best,
Chloe Martin
Manager, Security & Compliance
Redwood Inference
